description: Our best skill is story telling combined with a touch of technology.
summary:
We developed ways to enhance the ability a challenge a topic that isn't a strong suit and the reason we did it is because of our growing ambition of combining art and technology, to create a beautiful blend of art which is kept alive through a touch of technology, reaching the reader's heart by creating a vivid memory of our art and it addresses the challenge by not only using storytelling as the challenge suggested but also using technology to harmonize with the hackathon.

Our project is important because it addresses everything mentioned by the profound group of institution of NASA and not only that we also respected the fact that it's not only related to storytelling but it's a part of a hackathon, so we combined technological advances as well while not diluting the storytelling even for once.
details: This project depicts the story of the forgotten space rovers left behind on mars and moon
